aggregation_contract.level_pass_condition: every required gate in the level must equal passed
aggregation_contract.local_review_condition: every required L0-L5 gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.public_rc_condition: local_review_condition plus L6 must pass from a remote detached clone of the exact candidate commit
aggregation_contract.github_released_condition: public_rc_condition plus the release gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.skipped_policy: skipped is forbidden and must never aggregate to passed

levels.description: Product, API, package, adapter, feature track and source-RC distribution boundary agree.
The public start command launches one Studio URL and verifies the exact source revision, source-dirty state and real multi-agent runtime.
A provider-backed coordinator turn and at least one native specialist delegation produce durable canonical actions.
A registered baseline completes a real page-created task, uploaded Dataset, immutable approval, Run, independent evaluation, new input and delivery; existing recipes remain regression coverage.

A goal without a pre-existing domain Recipe completes page preparation, isolated qualification, an actual Run, independent evaluation, fresh input, package download and clean offline reload. Blockers alone do not pass. Model quality failures remain visible and separately assessed.

PC dialogue/actions at 1280x800,1440x900,1920x1080; refresh/re-entry, real stop and service-restart status without duplicate execution, preserved approvals/artifacts, readable evidence and no false success.

A remote detached clone of the exact candidate installs from committed locks, rebuilds the CPU image from the included recipe, starts a fresh runs/profile directory, repeats registered and generic page journeys, verifies package reload and restart.

The exact verified candidate passes remote CI, is merged, tagged v1.0.0-rc.2 and published as a GitHub Prerelease with source checksums and sanitized evidence; backend-only wheel is not the complete Studio.

release_scope.model_service: configurable adapter; real preview evidence names the exact verified provider
release_scope.model_quality: Reported independently; failed model quality must remain failed and does not invalidate an honest completed platform workflow
release_scope.examples: Representative tests, not a capability allowlist
